subject: English Home Language

show.line: Tricky letter teams! igh as in high. eigh as in eight. augh as in caught. ough as in tough!

rounds.prompt: Which word has igh, as in high?
Which word has eigh, as in eight?
rounds.praise: Yes! Weigh, like weighing on a scale.

rounds.prompt: This word has augh. It is what the teacher did when she showed you something new. Say it.
Tap the word that spells night the right way.
igh, eigh or augh? Sort the words by their letter team.
Which word has ough and rhymes with puff?

rounds.text: I caught eight fish last night.
accept: i caught eight fish last night

hints: These teams have a silent gh. Look at the letters before it.
igh says the sound in high. eigh says the sound in eight.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will spell the number eight.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Ate is what you did to your lunch. The number eight has eigh.

parent_line: Can read words with igh, eigh, augh and ough.
